name: The Kiss
description:
'The Kiss' is a tribute to the world-famous painting of the same name by Austrian artist Gustav Klimt and symbolizes the glorification of the love of man and woman. The couple seems merged in everlasting love. However, fusion always means dissolution of one's ego. Are we ready for this?

This is an Expansion Item for Forever Supper, the biggest cryptoart collaboration. Claim your free Core and customise it with the Expansions you collect here: https://async.market/dynamic-blueprints/63fe742c74e62000a8cf7bb8/async-forever-supper
